name: Year ruler to title
what: A tall ruler of years, out of focus at first, scrolls down with a tick and a big year every step, comes into focus, slows to a stop in the middle of the frame, then topples over to the left and is gone; a title then fades in word by word on a warm glow.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f34 the ruler scrolls down (the speed builds to ~55 px a frame at f17 and eases to a stop at f34), shrinking to 0.77 x and sliding to the middle; f0-f14 it comes into focus; f34-f44 it topples to the left about a point below the frame (an accelerating rotation); f46 it is gone; f55-f90 the title fades in word by word (a word every 12 f); then it holds to the end

tracks.name: scroll
tracks.what: the ruler scrolls down and eases to a stop

tracks.name: settle
tracks.what: the ruler shrinks to 0.77 x and slides to the middle of the frame

tracks.name: topple
tracks.what: the ruler topples to the left about a point below the frame and is gone

tracks.name: title
tracks.what: the title fades in word by word

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the title holds (the film grain moves)
